new_news.headline: Liquid Environmental Solutions Acquires Commercial Pumping Services
new_news.summary: Liquid Environmental Solutions has acquired Commercial Pumping Services, a leading provider of grease trap and used cooking oil collection services. Based in St. Charles County, MO and founded in 2000, Commercial Pumping Services will be added to LES' extensive network of non-hazardous wastewater collection facilities.

new_news.headline: Liquid Environmental Solutions Acquired by Goldman Sachs Infrastructure Fund
new_news.source: Multiple (ESG Today, Baird, Simpson Thacher, Audax)
new_news.summary: Goldman Sachs Alternatives announced an agreement by its infrastructure team to acquire non-hazardous liquid waste management services provider Liquid Environmental Solutions (LES), from Boston-based investor Audax Private Equity. Audax had acquired the company in Q4 2017 and executed a Buy & Build strategy, nearly doubling the company's footprint to over 90 locations across 50 states; LES executed 13 acquisitions that helped drive geographic growth and entry into adjacent services.

new_news.headline: Wind River Environmental Acquires Keystone Wastewater Services
new_news.summary: Wind River Environmental has acquired Keystone Wastewater Services, a well-established company specializing in grease pumping and drain cleaning with a 20+ year history in central Pennsylvania, Ohio, and Maryland. This acquisition expands Wind River's service footprint throughout Pennsylvania and enables it to better serve commercial customers.

new_news.headline: Wind River Environmental Acquires M&S Septic Services and Fenkner Septic Services
new_news.summary: Wind River Environmental has acquired M&S Septic Services and Fenkner Septic Services, two well-established companies with a 50+ year history specializing in septic pumping, installations, inspections, repairs and drain cleaning. These acquisitions add to Wind River's current service area in Pennsylvania and allow expansion to Matamoras and Greentown.

new_news.headline: Wind River Environmental Acquires Hapchuk, Inc. and Enters Agreement for Liquid Assets Disposal, Inc.
new_news.summary: Wind River Environmental has acquired Hapchuk, Inc., a well-established provider of grease pumping, septic pumping, and related environmental services. Wind River also entered into an agreement, pending regulatory approval, to purchase Liquid Assets Disposal, Inc., which operates a West Virginia-based treatment facility for grease, septic, and other non-hazardous liquid waste.

new_news.headline: EPA Finalizes Historic Renewable Fuel Standards for 2026 and 2027 at Record-High Volumes
new_news.summary: EPA finalized the RFS "Set 2" rule establishing the highest renewable fuel volume requirements in program history for 2026 and 2027, with 25.82 billion RINs in 2026 and 25.98 billion in 2027. The rule reallocates 70% of small refinery exemptions for 2023-2025 and removes renewable electricity from the program.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients: Avfuel Corporation Takes First Delivery of Sustainable Aviation Fuel from Diamond Green Diesel
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients announced that Avfuel Corporation received the first delivery of sustainable aviation fuel produced by Diamond Green Diesel from used cooking oil and animal fats, with DGD's Port Arthur facility converted to 50% SAF capacity.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients and Southwest Airlines SAF Supply Agreement via Diamond Green Diesel at Chicago Midway
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients' Diamond Green Diesel joint venture announced a two-year SAF supply agreement with Southwest Airlines for Chicago Midway International Airport, with Southwest purchasing a minimum of 3.6 million gallons of neat SAF.

new_news.headline: Diamond Green Diesel to Supply Sustainable Aviation Fuel to Florida via World Fuel and DHL Express
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients announced DGD will supply approximately 60 million gallons of blended SAF (18 million gallons neat SAF) to Florida over two years, produced from used cooking oil and food waste with at least 80% lower lifecycle GHG emissions.

new_news.headline: Update on the 2026-2027 Renewable Fuel Standard Biofuels Mandate
new_news.summary: Analysis of EPA's final 2026-2027 RFS volumes announcing record-high requirements with biomass-based diesel nearly doubling from 2025 levels. The rule includes projections of 41.9 billion gallons of renewable fuel supply growth over two years.

new_news.headline: Used Cooking Oil (UCO) Price Forecast: A Cornerstone Feedstock for Sustainable Aviation Fuel
new_news.summary: Fastmarkets analysis of UCO market dynamics showing 2024 US UCO usage reached 8.4 billion pounds (42% increase), but collection at only 3.3 billion pounds falls short of the industry's demand for 5.7 billion pounds, creating significant feedstock supply constraints.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Diversifies DGD Renewable Fuel Feedstock Supply with Valley Proteins and FASA Acquisitions
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients announced major acquisitions of Valley Proteins and FASA to support renewable fuels growth, with Valley Proteins producing enough fat for approximately 125 million gallons per year of renewable diesel.

new_news.headline: From Restaurant Kitchens to Commercial Jets: The Greasy Trail of Used Cooking Oil
new_news.summary: Washington Post investigation following used cooking oil collection from DC restaurants through Neste's Rotterdam refinery for SAF production, highlighting fuel companies' efforts to combat fraud and verify grease authenticity.

new_news.headline: Household Used Cooking Oil Collection: America's Untapped SAF Fuel and Curbside Programs
new_news.summary: Grease Connections overview of curbside household UCO collection programs and their expansion across US cities, noting that modest growth in collection could double current supply toward the federal SAF Grand Challenge target of 3 billion gallons by 2030.

new_news.headline: Used Cooking Oil Market Size, Trends & Forecast, 2026-2033
new_news.summary: Market analysis reporting Darling Ingredients' December 2024 delivery of first batch of neat SAF from Diamond Green Diesel to Avfuel, with DGD producing SAF from animal fats, used cooking oil, and other renewable feedstocks.

new_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Q1 2026 Earnings: Strong EPS Beat Despite Revenue Miss
new_news.summary: Darling Ingredients reported Q1 2026 net income of $134.3 million with EPS of $0.83, beating analyst expectations of $0.59 by 40.68%, though revenue of $1.55 billion slightly missed the $1.56 billion forecast. The company provided FY2026 revenue guidance of $6.54 billion and guided Q2 core ingredients EBITDA to $260-275 million, benefiting from improved Diamond Green Diesel performance and favorable renewable volume obligation developments.

new_news.headline: Clean Harbors Q1 2026 Earnings: Record Revenue and Raised Full-Year Guidance
new_news.summary: Clean Harbors reported record Q1 2026 revenue of $1.459 billion with net income of $63.2 million and EPS of $1.19, beating analyst expectations. Adjusted EBITDA rose 6% to $247.9 million with a 60 basis point margin expansion to 17.0%, driven by strong environmental services performance and higher base oil pricing. The company raised full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $1.24-1.30 billion.

new_news.headline: GFL Environmental Q1 2026 Earnings Call: Record Margins and Eight Acquisitions Completed
new_news.summary: GFL Environmental achieved the highest adjusted EBITDA margin in company history at 29.1%, with pricing growing 7.0% and organic growth of 4.6% in Q1 2026. The company completed eight acquisitions including Frontier Waste Solutions in Texas and announced a proposed acquisition of Secure Waste Infrastructure for Western Canada, with management maintaining target leverage of 3.0-3.5x.

new_news.headline: Clean Harbors Q1 2026 Results: 16th Consecutive Quarter of ES Margin Improvement
new_news.summary: Clean Harbors' Environmental Services segment delivered its 16th consecutive quarter of year-over-year adjusted EBITDA margin improvement, with field services revenue growing 7% as emergency response and PFAS-related business expanded. The company generated over $120 million in PFAS-related revenue in 2025 with expected 2026 growth in the 25-35% range.

new_news.headline: IoT-Based Industrial Equipment Monitoring System
new_news.source: International Journal of Latest Technology in Engineering, Management & Applied Science
new_news.summary: Academic paper describing IoT sensor systems for monitoring industrial equipment using accelerometers, temperature, oil leakage, and current sensors. While general industrial application, methodology relevant to grease trap monitoring and predictive maintenance.

new_news.headline: Junk Removal Business Insurance Cost (2026 Rates)
new_news.summary: Broad waste/junk removal insurance survey noting that disposal fees and regional regulations significantly affect both operations and risk exposure for hauling businesses.

new_news.headline: Erving Voters to Weigh Cemetery Expansion, Wastewater Treatment Plant Upgrades
new_news.summary: Erving, Massachusetts voters will decide on May 13 whether to approve a $1 million upgrade to the Erving Center Wastewater Treatment Plant, specifically updating secondary clarifiers installed in the 1970s. The town contracts with Erving Industries Inc. to operate the facility and maintains a cost-sharing agreement for maintenance and financing.

new_news.headline: Water Infrastructure Grants in 2026: CWSRF, IIJA Programs, and USDA Funding for Clean Water Projects
new_news.summary: Federal water infrastructure funding in 2026 totals billions through EPA's Clean Water and Drinking Water State Revolving Funds, with IIJA authorization running through FY2026. States are actively seeking projects to obligate remaining funds before the authorization window closes.
